info.headline: Severe Weather Warning for North East Pastoral and Flinders forecast districts
info.description:
DAMAGING WINDS averaging 60 to 75 km/h with peak gusts of around 110 km/h are possible about the higher parts of the northern Flinders Ranges. Conditions are forecast to ease by around sunrise this morning. Locations which may be affected include Arkaroola.
Severe weather is no longer occurring in the Mid North district and the warning for this district is CANCELLED.
info.instruction: The State Emergency Service advises that people should: * Move vehicles under cover or away from trees; * Secure or put away loose items around your property. * Stay indoors, away from windows, while conditions are severe.
